keyLimits.en: Up to 5 billable clients; basic invoicing, expense tracking, estimates, payment acceptance.
Up to 50 billable clients; proposals, client retainers, financial reports, receipt scanning, accountant access.
Unlimited billable clients; project profitability, custom email templates, line-item receipt capture.
Unlimited billable clients; lower transaction fees, dedicated support, 2 included team members, guided data migration, advanced permissions.

cautions.en: The pricing page displays heavily discounted promotional rates (Lite from $1/mo, Plus/Premium up to 80% off) that apply only for a limited introductory period; regular list prices ($23 / $43 / $70) were used here and should be reconfirmed at merge time in case they change.

capabilities.en: Invoicing, expense tracking, estimates and online payment acceptance for freelancers and small businesses.
Unlimited time tracking, automated bank imports, tax reports and a mobile app on all plans.

limitations.en: No permanent free plan; only a 30-day trial before a paid subscription is required.
Entry-level Lite plan caps billable clients at 5, forcing an upgrade as a freelancer's client base grows.

unknowns: Full integrations list and exact team-member limits per plan were not confirmed on an official page in this session.
